WITH invoice_line_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    COUNT(*) as line_item_count,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL 
          AND derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL 
          AND derived_total_cost != 0
        THEN derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost 
      END
    ) as cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
all_invoices_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM invoice_line_ratios
  WHERE cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ilr.invoice_number,
  ilr.cost_ratio,
  ilr.line_item_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN ilr.cost_ratio IS NOT NULL AND aia.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND aia.overall_avg != 0
    THEN ilr.cost_ratio / aia.overall_avg
  END as relative_ratio
FROM invoice_line_ratios ilr
CROSS JOIN all_invoices_avg aia
WHERE aia.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  relative_ratio IS NULL,
  relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Line items where derived_total_cost equals 0 are excluded from cost_ratio calculation (division by zero is undefined); similarly, lines with NULL derived_total_cost or NULL derived_product_cost are excluded, treating them as the "missing ones" the request refers to.

If the overall average cost ratio equals 0 (all invoices have cost_ratio = 0), relative_ratio is returned as NULL for all rows, since division by zero is undefined. The request does not address this edge case.
